name: Kepler
description:
Get citation-backed answers on public company financials, straight from SEC filings, earnings transcripts, and market data. Ask questions like "compare AAPL and MSFT gross margins over the last 4 quarters" or "build a 3-statement model for NVDA," and Kepler returns verified figures with every number traced back to its source document, page, and line item plus downloadable Excel workbooks for model requests.

Built for financial analysts such as buy-side analysts, equity researchers, and asset managers for all workflows where "probably right" isn't good enough.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Kepler to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Kepler to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.kepler.ai/api/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Kepler MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kepler provides these MCP tools: cancel_run, continue_research, continue_waiting, get_run_result, get_workbook_data, is_run_done, list_recent_runs, lookup_company, and run_financial_research.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Kepler?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Kepler in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Kepler requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Kepler is developed by Kepler. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
